en-US.author: CAST AI Group, Inc.
en-US.description: A terminal coding agent powered by multi-model orchestration.
en-US.longDescription: Kimchi is a terminal coding agent that routes tasks to different large language models by role, such as orchestrator, builder, reviewer, and explorer, through its multi-model orchestration.
en-US.name: Kimchi
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
New Features
- feat(sessions): record the harness build in every session by @MateuszOtmianowski in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1633
- feat(telemetry): stamp source and ACP client identity on OTLP metric data points by @michalsallem-prcstp in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1587
Bug Fixes
- redaction: scrub tool-result details in the tool_result hook by @josemonteiro in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1646
- fix(bash-background): never hold background processes without bash_control by @MateuszOtmianowski in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1648
- fix(deps): close product-side npm Dependabot alerts (12 of 13) by @MateuszOtmianowski in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1651
- fix(acp): re-abort on agent_start when the turn is already cancelled by @vmizg in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1630
- redaction: cut false positives in email and IP detection by @josemonteiro in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1652
- fix(telemetry): canonicalize tool errors, reclassify non-failure outcomes by @MateuszOtmianowski in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1641
- fix(lsp): evict dead language-server chains on write failure, label EPIPE errors by @cast-vytautas in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1595
- fix(export): exported sessions carry pi's system prompt instead of Kimchi's by @MateuszOtmianowski in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1658
Other Changes
- adding language settings to pin model response by @Mahamadou828 in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1624
Full Changelog: https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/compare/v1.28.1...v1.28.2

zh-CN.description: 由多模型编排驱动的终端编码代理。
zh-CN.longDescription: Kimchi 是一款终端编码代理，通过多模型编排按角色（编排者、构建者、审查者、探索者等）将任务路由到不同的大语言模型。
